stories.title: NRW urges people across Wales to ‘Be Flood Ready’
stories.summary: Following a summer marked by drought and wildfires Natural Resources Wales (NRW) is urging people across Wales not to become complacent about flood risk this autumn and winter. Communities across Wales experienced devastating flooding and storms last winter, before prolonged dry conditions, drought and significant wildfires affected many parts of the country during the summer.

stories.title: School leaders’ union and Welsh Government agree 14 working days of talks over pay and ALN funding
stories.summary: School leaders’ union NAHT Cymru and the Welsh Government have agreed to 14 working days of intensive negotiations to try to settle a dispute over pay, workload and school funding. Councils, as the employers, are represented by the Welsh Local Government Association, and the talks will also cover funding for pupils with additional learning needs
